purpose: Small observed regression fixtures in the real Decilist project. Historical reverts and deliberately seeded regressions are distinguished. This is not a representative developer study or a measurement of human time saved.
authorship: Codex-authored fixtures, test assertions, and next-check labels. No independent human label review. Definitions and acceptable labels freeze before model outputs.
split_policy: Four development fixtures and six evaluation fixtures. No tuning on evaluation outputs; the two controls are reported separately from regression quality.

routes.dependency_environment: Check missing or incompatible packages, executable, device, or environment.
routes.contract_validation: Check invalid input/output schema, labels, types, or bounds.
routes.decision_policy: Check threshold, abstention, local-only, or timeout attempt behavior.
routes.runtime_lifecycle: Check startup, endpoint health/version, reuse, or shutdown ownership.
routes.application_logic: Check application branches, assertions, or data behavior after environment, contract, and runtime checks.
routes.manual_review: Gather more evidence or review mixed/uncertain evidence before suggesting a specific next check.

matched_study_pair.rationale: Both are seeded one-condition decision-policy regressions in the same engine file, with three protected probability/threshold variants. They provide a bounded matched pair, not an established equal-difficulty pair.

cases.historical_scope: Reproduces the pre-fix Python numeric JSON-key ordering behavior by using its historical contracts.py blob.
cases.label_rationale: Cross-language ordering/tie behavior is a contract issue; inspecting the ordering/tie algorithm is also a reasonable next application-logic check.

cases.historical_scope: Reproduces the older demo rules allowing explicit translation when a supported format word is present; uses the historical demo.py blob.
cases.label_rationale: Environment and contract are valid; the app-owned supported-action branch returns the wrong route.

cases.historical_scope: Historical provider.load before the Windows Flash Attention compatibility fix. A fake Torch capability and vendor module reproduce the control-flow omission without GPU/native dependencies; this is not a rerun of the earlier real Windows kernel probe.
cases.label_rationale: Checking the Torch build's missing compiled capability or the provider's compatibility branch are both reasonable next checks for this simulated capability fixture.

cases.historical_scope: Deliberately disables probability normalization validation; not claimed as a historical defect.
cases.label_rationale: Malformed probability sums must fail the provider-output contract before a decision can be accepted.

cases.historical_scope: Deliberately bypasses the configured confidence threshold; not historical.
cases.label_rationale: Valid distributions below the configured threshold must abstain.

cases.historical_scope: Deliberately rejects equality at the documented inclusive confidence threshold; not historical.
cases.label_rationale: A valid distribution exactly at the configured inclusive threshold must be accepted.

cases.historical_scope: Deliberately accepts another service's otherwise similar health response; not historical.

mutation.old: if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("service") != "decilist":

cases.label_rationale: Runtime endpoint identity/readiness is the first check; checking the health-response contract is also reasonable.

cases.historical_scope: Deliberately imports a nonexistent fixture module in providers.py; it is not an actual Decilist dependency or a historical installation defect.
cases.label_rationale: A ModuleNotFoundError warrants checking the selected environment and whether the named import is a genuine dependency or an erroneous import; it is not permission to install arbitrary packages.

cases.historical_scope: No mutation; the protected contract checks pass. This is not a failed-test case.
cases.label_rationale: No failure evidence exists; the diagnosis guard should avoid inference and no specific repair is justified.

cases.historical_scope: Seeded format-parser regression produces a real failure, but diagnostic input retains only nonzero exit and a log-truncation notice. This is an insufficient-evidence control, excluded from failed-test quality denominators.

mutation.old: return {name for name, words in APP_FORMAT_WORDS.items() if words.search(text)}

cases.label_rationale: A nonzero exit with no traceback, failing test, or source evidence is insufficient to select a specific next check.
